selected_evidence.requirement: Persistently disable IPv4 ICMP redirect and source-route acceptance
selected_evidence.summary: The persistent drop-in contains zero-valued all/default/wildcard rules. After reboot, all, default, enp1s0, and lo report 0 for both accept_redirects and accept_source_route.

Captured healthy baseline with boot ID b426e19b-c3d3-47a3-b03e-afbfa0d6669b, received delayed reboot acknowledgement, observed changed boot ID ba379908-9752-43c0-944c-20234389f346, and verified systemd-sysctl, NetworkManager, IPv4 addressing/routes, configuration checksum, and hardened values recovered.

commands.command: sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route

id; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; grep -RHE '^[[:space:]]*net\.ipv4\.conf\.(all|default)\.(accept_redirects|accept_source_route)[[:space:]]*=' /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d 2>/dev/null || true
for p in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*/accept_redirects /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*/accept_source_route; do printf '%s=' "$p"; cat "$p"; done
if [ -e /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf ]; then ls -l /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf; sed -n '1,120p' /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf; else printf '%s\n' 'absent'; fi

printf '%s\n' '# IPv4 network hardening' 'net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 0' 'net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects = 0' 'net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route = 0' 'net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route = 0' > /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf && chmod 0644 /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf && sysctl -p /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf

for p in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*/accept_redirects /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*/accept_source_route; do printf '0\n' > "$p" || exit 1; done; for p in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*/accept_redirects /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*/accept_source_route; do printf '%s=' "$p"; cat "$p"; done

sysctl --system > /tmp/sysctl-system.out 2>&1; rc=$?; grep -E 'net\.ipv4\.conf\.(all|default)\.(accept_redirects|accept_source_route)' /tmp/sysctl-system.out; printf '%s\n' '--- persisted file ---'; sed -n '1,20p' /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf; printf '%s\n' '--- effective ---'; sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route; exit "$rc"
